0f54fca37041622b4afd.en: Newtalk News The Foreign and National Defence Committee of the Legislative Assembly invited today (14) the Ministry of Defense and Transport to report on a project for "relocation of Matsuyama Airport". In 2013, Minister Ku Richio announced that he would contest the primary election as Taipei's mayor from the Democratic Progressive Party. He had proposed relocating Matsuyama airport. When asked about his past statements, Ra Chi-Gong said that as Minister of Defense, he will place national defense resilience and military tasks first. In 25 years of running for Taipei' s mayor in 2004, Ku Richioo had suggested that after the opening of Taoyuan Airport Expressway, it could be considered to dismantle Matsuyama Airfield. Ra Chi-Gang questioned Ku Richioto saying that "the height limitation, construction restrictions and noise caused by Matsuyama airfield are very big obstacles to Taipei' S development, so Taiwan has made too much sacrifice, and after the transfer of Matsujama airport, there is plenty of space which can become the green corridor most popular with citizens."
